title: project.resource.export plan
description: The file this resource produces, where it goes, and the artifact record that makes it live. The path is derived from the recipe key, so a re-export never overwrites the output the current record describes — the failure that would leave an Artifact confidently pointing at bytes it does not match.

recipe_key.description: The artifact key this output was produced from: the object digest, the fully resolved recipe, the export profile and the tool version.

path.description: Where the file goes, relative to the project root.

sha256.description: The digest of the produced file, which is what a verify compares against the bytes on disk.

superseded.description: Artifact records this export replaces. Their files are reported and never deleted: nothing in this toolkit removes an artifact behind a person's back.
